tiers.name: Standard
tiers.note: 9–5 reactive support, remote-first. The essentials, done properly.
features: Microsoft 365 admin (users, mailboxes, Teams, SharePoint, permissions)
One primary device per user + share of one site included
Onsite visits when remote resolution is not possible, billed separately
Same SLA as Plus and Premium (see below)

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.note: Everything in Standard, plus priority handling, starter and leaver management, and a half-yearly roadmap.
features: Priority queue placement vs Standard (same SLA)

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.note: For businesses that want extended hours, project work bundled, and first-touch privilege.
features: First-touch queue privilege (within same SLA priority)
2 hours of quarterly project work bundled
Quarterly review with vendor + licence rationalisation

universalInclusions.title: Microsoft 365 backup
universalInclusions.desc: Independent third-party backup of mail, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams. Microsoft doesn't fully protect this by default.

universalInclusions.title: Huntress EDR + identity threat detection
universalInclusions.desc: 24/7 managed threat hunting on every endpoint and every M365 identity. Real humans, not just alerts.

universalInclusions.title: Cyber Essentials maintenance + evidence pack
universalInclusions.desc: Year-round controls and annual evidence pack ready for assessment. Certification fee set by IASME based on company size.

universalInclusions.title: Cloudflare DNS management
universalInclusions.desc: We manage your DNS so a web host or marketing agency can't silently break your email or domain.

universalInclusions.title: DMARC management
universalInclusions.desc: Full DMARC policy management: protects your domain reputation and is increasingly required for inbox deliverability.

universalInclusions.title: Basic shared webhosting
universalInclusions.desc: Simple business website hosting if you need it, no extra contract, no separate invoice.

universalInclusions.title: Domain renewal absorbed (standard TLDs)
universalInclusions.desc: We cover the annual renewal cost of standard TLDs (.co.uk, .com, .uk, .org, .net, .net.uk, .me.uk). Premium TLDs billed at cost, no markup. Domain stays registered in your name; if you leave, it goes with you.

objections.a: We coordinate everything with your outgoing IT company. Your staff won't notice a thing; they'll just start getting faster responses. Zero downtime. We've done this dozens of times.

objections.q: "We don't want to be locked in."
objections.a: 12-month agreements with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Not happy in the first month? Full refund, no questions asked. We keep clients by being good, not by trapping them.

objections.q: "How do we know you'll actually respond quickly?"
objections.a: Available helpdesk averages are shown on the contact page. Contact us to discuss the response commitments included in your support agreement.
